description_en: Queries the blacklisted IP addresses for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --query-type example-string --key-word 138 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoCcBlacklist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The keyword for a fuzzy search. The value is a prefix of the source IP address that you want to query.

The keyword must be more than three characters long
parameters.help_zh:
使用源IP关键字查询，指定要查询的源IP的前缀。

必须大于3个字符
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return for a paged query. For example, to query the results on the first page, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page
parameters.name: page_size
